title: Painter’s palette
description: Sculpted pigment daubs select a hue for a knife-painted swatch, with independent lightness and a usable hex value.
useCase: Tactile color selection for creative tools, brush settings and themed interfaces.
interaction: Choose a pigment, then adjust Lightness. Arrow keys move through the two rows; Home and End jump to the first and last pigment.
reducedMotion: Selection and swatch updates remain immediate. Reduced motion removes the small press deformation; keyboard and paused-host interactions skip transitions.
limitations: Twelve preset HSL hues with fixed saturation per pigment; lightness ranges from 15 to 85 percent. The paint is illustrated SVG, not a physical or subtractive pigment-mixing model. No opacity or color-management controls.
look: Skeuomorphic wooden palette on warm off-white with two rows of glossy paint daubs, a broad knife stroke, and a hex readout and gradient slider beneath.
motion: Pressing a daub squashes it slightly over 120 ms and hover brightens it; selection and the lightness slider recolour the knife stroke and hex value instantly.
adapt: Hues and saturations live in `PIGMENTS`, `color` converts HSL to the hex shown, and the press squash is the `sf-painter-daub` transition plus its `:active` scale. `PaintDaub` draws each blob; wire `setSelected` and `lightness` to your own colour state.
